overview: The Royal Guard Barracks is the operational center of Shar Vahl’s elite palace defenders.
history: The barracks were built alongside the earliest palace structures.
Royal Guard drillmasters established formal training regimens.
Armories were expanded to support ceremonial and defensive duties.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the barracks were reinforced and terraced.
Shadow-Threat Watch began coordinating with the Royal Guard here.
hooks: A drill session destabilizes an armory rack.
A muster call reveals an urgent palace threat.
A Shadow-Threat liaison requests immediate guard support.
